body: Ok, I know Rile made the Avicus hoodie. This is more for people who enjoy having a T-shirt rather then a hoodie on their Minecraft skin. If you want one just say something to indicate that you want one. I just made it for fun when I was bored :P.Sincerely, ~Nebbae
